Telangana Men Allegedly Recruited for Russian Frontline After Job Promises

Four men from Telangana, who were seeking civilian employment in Russia, have allegedly been sent to the Russian frontline after being promised jobs. Their families have approached authorities seeking intervention to locate the men and secure their return. The men had reportedly travelled to Russia in search of work.
